Description: Summon forth your tourmaline golem, and make yourself the envy of gemstone collectors.
DescriptionEnhanced: This resplendent golem is believed to have been fashioned by a mage of eld, who went to considerable lengths to gather the requisite tourmaline. The variegated hues seen across its body arise from the use of precious bicolored stones, which are highly sought after by collectors.
Tooltip:
Finding the gilded tourmaline egg
was only the beginning!
   - Nonotta

Description: Summon forth your Cu Sith, a beastmaster's best friend.
DescriptionEnhanced: This dog-like beast encountered in the Black Shroud is a surpassing rare sight in Eorzea. After forging a bond with you, the creature went on to show tremendous development, and proved its worth against the fearsome Guttler─a transformation driven in no small part by its desire to bear you upon its back.
Tooltip:
You and your Cu Sith have more in common
than you might have dreamthought!
   - Loosefrox

Description: Summon forth your hydra. All three heads guaranteed to mean business or your money back.
DescriptionEnhanced: Appearing to be a three-headed dragon, the hydra is in truth a product of chimerical experiments on dragonkind. While the creature has been blessed with transcendent might and vitality, its intelligence remains that of an ordinary beast, meaning it can be tamed by a skilled beastmaster.
Tooltip:
I was bloody *sure* ye'd
be hydra dung by now...
   - Gerolt
